svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 07 / SPACE INVADERS
svg.desc: 17,506 GitHub contributions across 153 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-29. The ship fires at real contribution dates in ascending count order. Invaders disappear only on projectile impact. A streak of seven consecutive active dates unlocks a boss.
